company.name: Suez Canal Economic Zone
company.shortDescription: A world-class economic zone, Industrial and trade hub along the banks of the Suez Canal. A 455 km2 of 4 Industrial Zones & 6 ports.
company.description:
SCZONE is a world-class economic zone, Industrial and trade hub along the banks of the Suez Canal. Strategically located on the main trade route between Europe and South Asia.
Spanning 455 km2, SCZONE has four unique industrial zones and six strategically-located ports.

productsAndServices.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone comprises four industrial zones designed to support various sectors including textiles, automotive, and pharmaceuticals.
productsAndServices.name: Industrial Zones

productsAndServices.description: SCZONE includes six ports that facilitate international trade and logistics, enhancing connectivity between Asia, Africa, and Europe.
productsAndServices.name: Ports

productsAndServices.description: SCZONE offers streamlined services for business setup and operations, reducing the time required to incorporate a company to 48 hours.
productsAndServices.name: One-Stop-Shop Services

productsAndServices.description: The zone provides comprehensive infrastructure including roads, railways, tunnels, and desalination plants to support industrial and commercial activities.
productsAndServices.name: Integrated Infrastructure

productsAndServices.description: SCZONE presents diverse investment opportunities across sectors such as logistics, petrochemicals, and renewable energy.
productsAndServices.name: Investment Opportunities

productsAndServices.description: The zone offers bunkering services to support maritime activities, contributing to its role as a regional energy hub.
